verdict.rationale: Thoropass documents Unified Controls, a single core control list that auditors mapped across its frameworks. It publishes SOC 2, HIPAA and HITRUST mapping guides, lets users filter controls by framework, and offers multi-framework action items that skip requirements another framework already covers and visualize the differences between frameworks. Missing for 10: any evidence that ISO 27001 is part of the mapping, explicit documentation that evidence (not just controls and action items) is reused automatically across frameworks, a clearly documented overlap view, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a security engineer, controls and evidence map ACROSS frameworks — work done for SOC 2 counts toward ISO 27001 and HIPAA automatically, with the overlap shown
